name: Stored water
summary: Water already stored somewhere: bottles and jugs, water heaters, pipes, header tanks and toilet cisterns.
uses: Drinking, after treatment if you’re unsure of it
identify: Bottled water and 19-litre cooler jugs in offices and shops; 150–300 litres in every tank water heater (cut power or gas and let it cool before draining); water in the pipes of tall buildings, loft header tanks and toilet cisterns (not bowls). Pools and hot tubs hold tonnes for washing and filtering.
test: Look and smell: clear and odourless is a good start. Treat anything not from a sealed bottle by boiling, chlorine or filtering.

decay.note: Sealed bottles keep for years; open tanks grow algae and bacteria.
